name: wiseppc
description: Amazon Ads and seller analytics for WisePPC. Connects Claude Code to the WisePPC MCP server for analytics, and submits changes that a person approves in WisePPC or that are sent directly, as your API key's grants decide.

api_key.title: WisePPC API key
api_key.description: API key created on the API keys page of the WisePPC webapp (starts with wpp_ak_). Enter it only in this secure field, never in chat.
